about: Limits for scripts/comments.js per comment level: the share of comment lines among the lines a change added (checked from min_lines_for_share added lines) and the longest comment block (the file header is not limited). project_hint: the level configure suggests from the share of comment lines in the code as it is. Calibrated on live runs. refs_exempt: files where ticket, decision-record and commit ids are their own subject, so comments.js does not report them (the project adds its own in comments.refs_exempt).
